sloka: ततो रामो धनुष् पाणिः तौ उभौ समुदैक्षत ।अन्योन्य सदृशौ वीरौ उभौ देवौ इव अश्विनौ ॥४-१२-१९॥
transliteration: tato rāmo dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ tau ubhau samudaikṣata ।anyonya sadṛśau vīrau ubhau devau iva aśvinau ॥4-12-19॥

translations.english: Bow in hand, Rama watched both the heroes who resembled the twin Aswini Kumaras.
